# 🧪 Experiment Record

## Question and hypothesis
What are you trying to learn?

## Implementation
Commit SHA, app entry point and algorithm version.

## Data
Synthetic dataset generation, seed, number of rows, feature schema and target distribution. Never include private data.

## Environment
Python version, package versions, OS and hardware if relevant.

## Procedure
Steps, parameters and evaluation protocol.

## Metrics
Define metrics and whether they are training, validation or test metrics.

## Results
Record actual measurements and uncertainty. Do not invent values.

## Interpretation
Explain what the experiment supports and what it does not prove.

## Reproduction
Exact commands and expected artifact paths.
